_note: Playstyle for the earlier, unmarked Gideon Mourne, from the Retro tournament report the list comes from (docs/tournament_import.md, Freestyle Vegeta). Energy beatdown on his own named cards. Rush Aspect 2, whose constant shuts the rival's Combat cards out and adds 2 wounds to every attack: Mourne's Low Blow pays 3 Fervor on a hit, so Fervor and the climb are worth a lot early. Five Aspects, so against a three-Aspect rival the Ascension route is live. Play thin and let hits land, because Mourne's Ruinous Bolt makes the bottom of the discard pile his named cards and Mourne Calls In Debts shuffles them all back: the Life Deck is a resource, not a wall. Mourne Bides His Time is the engine card, and Voss' Clear Mind and Recalled Lesson go and get it, so the tutor chain is priced. Aspect 3 strips the hand entering Combat, and the Lunges and Appraisals keep it thin.
name: mercenary_lord
